mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies at Verona Community Park with a temperature of 39 degrees. The ISS will pass overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. The moon is currently in a Waning Gibbous phase.

In city news, candidate information packets for the upcoming 2027 election are now available. Please note that all candidacy forms must be submitted by 5 p.m. on January 5, 2027, to the City Clerk at 111 Lincoln Street. Additionally, property tax bills will be mailed no later than December 15.

We have plenty of local happenings this week. Today, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness or join the festivities at Art House 360. Tomorrow, be sure to check out live music at Bailey's Run or head over to Wisconsin Brewing Company for their 50 years of craft brewing celebration.

In our weekly report, on November 2, officers were dispatched to a residence on West End Circle following a domestic disturbance, which resulted in a 48-year-old man being arrested for battery and disorderly conduct.
The Culver's of Verona location is currently closed for the day. We look forward to tomorrow, when the doors will open at 10:00 AM featuring the Snickers Swirl flavor of the day.
